value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "To support automated feedback interpretation, we implemented participatory structures (Tabak & Baumgartner, 2004), including collaborative group reflection (Kollar & Fischer, 2010) and teacher guidance."
